column1: # The exercise table (DESIGN_exercise_table.md §3): one class of exercises per line.
# A Garmin name is CATEGORY/NAME; a bare CATEGORY is a set tagged with the category and no
# exercise. The names of a line are the Garmin names whose kilograms compare: the plain
# exercise, then its WEIGHTED_ twin, then the bare category. They share one category.
# Garmin drops a leading underscore after WEIGHTED_: the twin of PLANK/_45_DEGREE_PLANK is
# THE FIRST NAME OF A LINE IS ITS KEY, AND THE DATABASE STORES IT. Never reorder the names of
# a line and never rename the first one. A name Garmin adds later is appended to its line, or
# gets a line of its own.
# A line starting with "+" is an exercise Garmin has no name for (§3.3). The "+" is a mark in
# this file, not part of the key. The comment above it names the nearest Garmin exercise.
# pattern: the job the exercise does in a session, or empty when it has none (§3.4).
# muscles: the main ones, then "|", then the secondary ones, in Garmin's words (§3.5).
# gear: everything the exercise needs, from the 46 words of §3.6, separated by ", ".
# photos: the id of the same exercise in Free Exercise DB (public domain), when it has one
